text:
morgan: quick accessibility run on the Compact Panel (sidebar mini-cards). Two small but user-facing nits: (1) checkbox labels inside cards are not programmatically associated (screen readers say "checkbox" only), and (2) keyboard focus outline is clipped when card expands. repro + notes below.

morgan: repro (short):
``` 
1) Console > Workspace > Compact view
2) Tab to a card and try the checkbox toggle
3) VoiceOver/NVDA reads "checkbox" no label; if you Expand the card the focus outline is partially hidden by overflow: hidden
```

tess: ugh, I hit this too. I think we render the checkbox as an unlabeled input with a visually-hidden label that isn't bound via for/id. Also the card expansion animates height and uses overflow hidden which clips :focus-visible ring.

noah: fix ideas:
- checkbox: ensure <label for="..."> text </label> or use aria-label on the input. Prefer explicit label for better hit target.
- expansion: when expanding set overflow: visible for the card during focus, or move the focus ring outside via outline-offset and box-shadow.

raja: small code snippets:
```html
<label for="card-42-include">Include in snapshot</label>
<input id="card-42-include" type="checkbox" />
```
and for focus ring: 
```css
.card:focus-within { overflow: visible; }
.card .focusable:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--focus-ring); outline-offset: 2px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(34,197,94,0.12); }
```

morgan: also saw color contrast fail on the muted label text inside collapsed cards in high-contrast mode. token currently --muted: #9CA3AF on light bg; fails on HC. proposal: use #6B7280 for body small-text when HC enabled.

tess: good call. We should run these through axe + color contrast tool. Add a small visual regression test for the focus ring so it doesn't get clipped in future.

noah: screen reader behavior: prefer announced labels like "Include in snapshot, checkbox, unchecked". If we toggle, send a polite aria-live update: "Included: customers.csv" or "Removed from snapshot". Keep live updates concise.

raja: implementation note: avoid changing DOM order for visual reasons. Keep label + input next to each other in source so NVDA/VO pick them up. If we must visually move elements, use CSS only.

morgan: I've created https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/issues/4599 with repro GIF, suggested patch, and color contrast proof. Marked as P1 for accessibility.

tess: test checklist for the issue: keyboard tab order, VoiceOver on macOS, NVDA on Windows, axe-core run, and a screenshot for contrast. I'll QA once the branch is up.

noah: small unit/e2e changes: update component tests to assert label association (`getByLabelText`) instead of `getByRole('checkbox')` only. Add a Puppeteer step to expand a card and assert outline is visible (pixel check).

raja: deploy plan: low-risk patch, suggest landing in 1.18.4 as an accessibility patch. If CSS layering gets funky we can revert quickly.

morgan: pinging here when PR is ready. thanks all.

a11y-bot: reminder: add to release notes under "accessibility" and include the VoiceOver/NVDA QA signoffs before closing the issue.
